# Bootstrap prediction intervals

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(glmnet)
library(splines)


WLAG <- 3L
N_STATES <- 50L
B <- 500L
FEATURES_PER <- 21L
LAMBDAS <- 10^seq(3, -2, by = -0.1)

STATE_SEED_BASE <- 10000L
CV_SEED_BASE <- 20000L
ORIGIN_CV_SEED_BASE <- 30000L
POINT_SEED_BASE <- 9000L

BOOTSTRAP_DIR <- "results/bootstrap"
INTERVAL_DIR <- "results/intervals"
WITH_FILE <- file.path(BOOTSTRAP_DIR, "with_admissions.rds")
WITHOUT_FILE <- file.path(BOOTSTRAP_DIR, "without_admissions.rds")
dir.create(BOOTSTRAP_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(INTERVAL_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  ~state, ~population,

  "PA", 13002700, "IL", 12812508, "OH", 11799448, "GA", 10711908,
  "NC", 10439388, "MI", 10077331, "NJ", 9288994,  "VA", 8631393,
  "WA", 7705281,  "AZ", 7151502,  "MA", 7029917,  "TN", 6910840,
  "IN", 6785528,  "MD", 6177224,  "MO", 6154913,  "WI", 5893718,
  "CO", 5773714,  "MN", 5706494,  "SC", 5118425,  "AL", 5024279,
  "LA", 4657757,  "KY", 4505836,  "OR", 4237256,  "OK", 3959353,
  "CT", 3605944,  "IA", 3190369,  "UT", 3271616,  "NV", 3104614,
  "AR", 3011524,  "MS", 2961279,  "KS", 2937880,  "NM", 2117522,
  "NE", 1961504,  "ID", 1839106,  "WV", 1793716,  "HI", 1455271,
  "NH", 1377529,  "ME", 1362359,  "RI", 1097379,  "MT", 1084225,
  "DE", 989948,   "SD", 886667,   "ND", 779094,   "AK", 733391,
  "VT", 643077,   "WY", 576851

stopifnot(
  exists("final_data"),
  exists("all_lag3_46"),
  exists("predictor_block_exclusions"),
  exists("make_Xdata_train"),
  exists("make_Xdata_test"),
  exists("make_Xlist_new_labeled"),

final_data <- final_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state), date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(date, state)

stopifnot(
  nrow(final_data) == 3500,
  dplyr::n_distinct(final_data$state) == 50,
  dplyr::n_distinct(final_data$date) == 70,
  !anyDuplicated(final_data[c("state", "date")]),
  all(rle(as.character(final_data$date))$lengths == 50)

all_states <- sort(unique(final_data$state))

make_model_spec <- function(has_admissions, id_prefix) {
  selected <- all_lag3_46 %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_hospitalization == has_admissions) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(median_state_rmse_46, k, combo_index) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)
  stopifnot(nrow(selected) == 1L)
  combo <- combn(12, selected$k, simplify = FALSE)[[selected$combo_index]]
  excluded <- unique(unlist(lapply(
    predictor_block_exclusions[intersect(names(predictor_block_exclusions), as.character(combo))],
    function(rule) rule$states
  )))
  list(
    k = selected$k, combo_index = selected$combo_index, combo = combo,
    eligible_states = setdiff(all_states, excluded), id_prefix = id_prefix
  )
}

MODEL_SPECS <- list(
  with = make_model_spec(TRUE, "BOOT_%03d"),
  without = make_model_spec(FALSE, "BOOTSTATE_%03d")
)

glmnet::glmnet.control(factory = TRUE)
```

```{r}
fold_bounds <- function(i, n_states = N_STATES) {

  if (i == 1L) {
    return(list(
      tr_s = 1L,
      tr_e = n_states * 20L,
      te_s = n_states * 15L + 1L,
      te_e = n_states * 30L
    ))
  }

  tr_s <- (i - 2L) * (n_states * 10L) + (n_states * 5L + 1L)
  te_s <- (i - 1L) * (n_states * 10L) + (n_states * 15L + 1L)

  list(
    tr_s = tr_s,
    tr_e = tr_s + n_states * 25L - 1L,
    te_s = te_s,
    te_e = te_s + n_states * 15L - 1L
  )
}

fold_data <- function(i) {
  fb <- fold_bounds(i)
  list(
    train = final_data[fb$tr_s:fb$tr_e, , drop = FALSE],
    test  = final_data[fb$te_s:fb$te_e, , drop = FALSE]
  )
}


study_dates <- sort(unique(as.Date(final_data$date)))

origin_fold_data <- function(i, target_week) {
  fw <- fold_weeks(i)
  origin_week <- target_week - WLAG
  stopifnot(origin_week >= fw$train[1] + 5L, origin_week < fw$train[2])
  tr <- week_rows(c(fw$train[1], origin_week), N_STATES)
  te <- week_rows(c(target_week - 5L, target_week), N_STATES)
  list(
    train = final_data[tr[1]:tr[2], , drop = FALSE],
    test  = final_data[te[1]:te[2], , drop = FALSE],
    target_date = study_dates[target_week],
    origin_date = study_dates[origin_week]
  )
}

AFFECTED <- lapply(1:5, function(i) affected_targets(i, WLAG))
stopifnot(all(lengths(AFFECTED) == WLAG - 1L))


make_original_foldids <- function(k, combo_index) {

  combinations <- combn(12, k, simplify = FALSE)
  stopifnot(combo_index >= 1L, combo_index <= length(combinations))

  selected <- vector("list", 5L)

  set.seed(237)

  for (outer_fold in 1:5) {

    y_train <- make_y_labeled(fold_data(outer_fold)$train)

    for (i in seq_along(combinations)) {

      mask <- get_exclusion_mask(
        combo_idx = combinations[[i]],
        state_vec = y_train$state,
        date_vec = y_train$date,
        exclusion_rules = predictor_block_exclusions
      )

      foldid <- sample(rep(seq_len(10L), length.out = sum(!mask)))

      if (i == combo_index) selected[[outer_fold]] <- foldid
    }
  }

  selected
}

make_bootstrap_train_data <- function(train_data, sampled_states, id_prefix) {

  purrr::imap_dfr(sampled_states, function(source_state, j) {
    train_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(state == source_state) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(date) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(state = sprintf(id_prefix, j))
  }) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(date, state)
}
```

```{r}
fit_one_fold <- function(
    train_data,
    test_data,
    spec,
    train_exclusion_rules,
    foldid = NULL,
    cv_seed = NULL,
    n_targets = 10L
) {

  X_train_result <- make_Xdata_train(
    dataset = train_data,
    lag = WLAG,
    ylag = WLAG,
    exclusion_rules = train_exclusion_rules
  )

 
  X_test_data <- make_Xdata_test(
    dataset = test_data,
    lag = WLAG,
    ylag = WLAG,
    bs_objects_from_train = X_train_result$bs_objects,
    exclusion_rules = predictor_block_exclusions
  )

  X_train_labeled <- make_Xlist_new_labeled(X_train_result$data)
  X_test_labeled  <- make_Xlist_new_labeled(X_test_data)
  y_train_labeled <- make_y_labeled(train_data)
  y_test_labeled  <- make_y_labeled(test_data)

  key <- function(labeled) {
    paste(as.character(labeled$state), as.character(as.Date(labeled$date)))
  }

  stopifnot(
    identical(key(X_train_labeled), key(y_train_labeled)),
    identical(key(X_test_labeled), key(y_test_labeled)),
    dplyr::n_distinct(y_test_labeled$date) == n_targets
  )

  if (n_targets == 1L) {
    stopifnot(max(y_train_labeled$date) <= min(y_test_labeled$date) - 7 * WLAG)
  }

  X_train_combo <- do.call(
    cbind, lapply(X_train_labeled$X_list[spec$combo], as.matrix)
  )
  X_test_combo <- do.call(
    cbind, lapply(X_test_labeled$X_list[spec$combo], as.matrix)
  )

  storage.mode(X_train_combo) <- "double"
  storage.mode(X_test_combo) <- "double"

  stopifnot(
    ncol(X_train_combo) == spec$k * FEATURES_PER,
    ncol(X_test_combo) == spec$k * FEATURES_PER
  )

  mask_train <- get_exclusion_mask(
    spec$combo, X_train_labeled$state, X_train_labeled$date,
    train_exclusion_rules
  )
  mask_test <- get_exclusion_mask(
    spec$combo, X_test_labeled$state, X_test_labeled$date,
    predictor_block_exclusions
  )

  X_train_f <- X_train_combo[!mask_train, , drop = FALSE]
  y_train_f <- y_train_labeled$obs[!mask_train]
  X_test_f  <- X_test_combo[!mask_test, , drop = FALSE]
  y_test_f  <- y_test_labeled$obs[!mask_test]

  stopifnot(
    all(is.finite(X_train_f)), all(is.finite(y_train_f)),
    all(is.finite(X_test_f)),  all(is.finite(y_test_f))
  )

  if (is.null(foldid)) {
    stopifnot(!is.null(cv_seed))
    set.seed(cv_seed)
    foldid <- sample(rep(seq_len(10L), length.out = nrow(X_train_f)))
  }

  stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_train_f))

  warning_messages <- character(0)

  cv_fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    glmnet::cv.glmnet(
      x = X_train_f, y = y_train_f, alpha = 1, family = poisson(link = "log"),
      lambda = LAMBDAS, standardize = TRUE, foldid = foldid
    ),
    warning = function(w) {
      warning_messages <<- c(warning_messages, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )


  y_pred <- as.numeric(
    predict(cv_fit, type = "response", s = cv_fit$lambda.min, newx = X_test_f)
  )

  stopifnot(all(is.finite(y_pred)), all(y_pred >= 0))

  pred <- tibble::tibble(
    state = as.character(X_test_labeled$state[!mask_test]),
    date = as.Date(X_test_labeled$date[!mask_test]),
    obs = y_test_f,
    pred = y_pred
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES)

  stopifnot(nrow(pred) == 46L * n_targets, dplyr::n_distinct(pred$state) == 46L)

  list(pred = pred, warnings = warning_messages, lambda_min = cv_fit$lambda.min)
}
```

```{r}
replace_target_rows <- function(pred_base, pred_refit, target_date) {

  stopifnot(
    nrow(pred_refit) == 46L,
    all(pred_refit$date == target_date),
    sum(pred_base$date == target_date) == 46L
  )

  key_base  <- paste(pred_base$state,  pred_base$date)
  key_refit <- paste(pred_refit$state, pred_refit$date)
  stopifnot(anyDuplicated(key_base) == 0L, all(key_refit %in% key_base))

  idx <- match(key_refit, key_base)
  stopifnot(all(abs(pred_base$obs[idx] - pred_refit$obs) < 1e-12))

  pred_base$pred[idx] <- pred_refit$pred
  pred_base
}


verify_point_estimate <- function(model_name, reference_object) {

  spec <- MODEL_SPECS[[model_name]]
  foldids <- make_original_foldids(spec$k, spec$combo_index)
  stopifnot(nrow(reference_object$replaced) == 5L * (WLAG - 1L))

  reproduced <- purrr::map_dfr(1:5, function(i) {
    fd <- fold_data(i)
    base <- fit_one_fold(
      train_data = fd$train, test_data = fd$test, spec = spec,
      train_exclusion_rules = predictor_block_exclusions,
      foldid = foldids[[i]]
    )$pred
    for (dj in seq_along(AFFECTED[[i]])) {
      od <- origin_fold_data(i, AFFECTED[[i]][dj])
      seed <- POINT_SEED_BASE + 1000000L * WLAG + 100000L * i + 10000L * dj + spec$combo_index
      refit <- fit_one_fold(
        od$train, od$test, spec, predictor_block_exclusions,
        cv_seed = seed, n_targets = 1L
      )$pred
      base <- replace_target_rows(base, refit, od$target_date)
    }
    base
  }) %>% dplyr::arrange(state, date)

  reference <- reference_object$y_predicted_new[[spec$combo_index]] %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      state = as.character(state),
      date = as.Date(date),
      obs = as.numeric(obs),
      pred = as.numeric(pred)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(state, date)

  stopifnot(
    nrow(reproduced) == 2300L,
    nrow(reference) == 2300L,
    identical(
      paste(reproduced$state, reproduced$date),
      paste(reference$state, reference$date)
    )
  )

  max_obs_diff <- max(abs(reproduced$obs - reference$obs))
  max_pred_diff <- max(abs(reproduced$pred - reference$pred))

  median_rmse <- reproduced %>%
    dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::summarise(m = median(rmse)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(m)


  stopifnot(max_obs_diff < 1e-10, max_pred_diff < 1e-6)

  invisible(median_rmse)
}

```

```{r}
one_replicate <- function(b, spec, model_name) {

  set.seed(STATE_SEED_BASE + b)
  sampled_states <- sample(spec$eligible_states, size = length(spec$eligible_states), replace = TRUE)

  lambda_rows  <- list()
  warning_rows <- list()

  fold_preds <- lapply(1:5, function(i) {

    fd <- fold_data(i)
    boot_train <- make_bootstrap_train_data(fd$train, sampled_states, spec$id_prefix)
    cv_seed <- CV_SEED_BASE + (b - 1L) * 10L + i

    fit <- fit_one_fold(boot_train, fd$test, spec, train_exclusion_rules = NULL,
                        cv_seed = cv_seed, n_targets = 10L)
    pred_i <- fit$pred

    lambda_rows[[length(lambda_rows) + 1L]] <<- tibble::tibble(
      boot = b, fold = i, refit = 0L, target_week = NA_integer_,
      cv_seed = cv_seed, lambda_min = fit$lambda_min
    )
    if (length(fit$warnings) > 0L) {
      warning_rows[[length(warning_rows) + 1L]] <<- tibble::tibble(
        boot = b, fold = i, refit = 0L, cv_seed = cv_seed, warning = fit$warnings
      )
    }
    for (dj in seq_along(AFFECTED[[i]])) {

      tw <- AFFECTED[[i]][dj]
      od <- origin_fold_data(i, tw)
      boot_train_o <- make_bootstrap_train_data(od$train, sampled_states, spec$id_prefix)
      cv_seed_o <- ORIGIN_CV_SEED_BASE + (b - 1L) * 100L + i * 10L + dj
      fit_o <- fit_one_fold(boot_train_o, od$test, spec, train_exclusion_rules = NULL,
                            cv_seed = cv_seed_o, n_targets = 1L)
      pred_i <- replace_target_rows(pred_i, fit_o$pred, od$target_date)

      lambda_rows[[length(lambda_rows) + 1L]] <<- tibble::tibble(
        boot = b, fold = i, refit = dj, target_week = tw,
        cv_seed = cv_seed_o, lambda_min = fit_o$lambda_min
      )
      if (length(fit_o$warnings) > 0L) {
        warning_rows[[length(warning_rows) + 1L]] <<- tibble::tibble(
          boot = b, fold = i, refit = dj, cv_seed = cv_seed_o, warning = fit_o$warnings
        )
      }
    }

    pred_i
  })

  pred_b <- dplyr::bind_rows(fold_preds) %>% dplyr::arrange(state, date)

  stopifnot(
    nrow(pred_b) == 2300L,
    dplyr::n_distinct(pred_b$state) == 46L,
    all(dplyr::count(pred_b, state)$n == 50L),
    all(is.finite(pred_b$pred))
  )

  list(
    pred = pred_b %>% dplyr::mutate(boot = b),
    lambda = dplyr::bind_rows(lambda_rows),
    warnings = dplyr::bind_rows(warning_rows)
  )
}


save_bootstrap_rds <- function(object, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  parent <- normalizePath(dirname(path), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  path <- file.path(parent, basename(path))
  if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows" && nchar(path) > 240L) {
    stop("Use a shorter output directory: ", path)
  }
  if (file.exists(path)) stop("File already exists: ", path)
  temp <- tempfile(pattern = "pending_", tmpdir = parent, fileext = ".rds")
  saved_complete <- FALSE
  on.exit({ if (!saved_complete && file.exists(temp)) unlink(temp) }, add = TRUE)
  saveRDS(object, temp)
  saved_complete <- TRUE
  if (file.exists(path) || !file.rename(temp, path)) {
    stop("Could not save to ", path, ". Completed RDS retained at ", temp)
  }
  invisible(path)
}

run_bootstrap <- function(model_name, B) {
  spec <- MODEL_SPECS[[model_name]]
  fit_functions <- c(
    "apply_predictor_exclusions", "make_lag_features", "fit_bs_preserve_na",
    "predict_bs_preserve_na", "make_Xdata_train", "make_Xdata_test",
    "make_Xlist_new_labeled", "make_y_labeled", "get_exclusion_mask",
    "fold_weeks", "week_rows", "affected_targets", "fold_bounds", "fold_data",
    "origin_fold_data", "make_original_foldids", "make_bootstrap_train_data",
    "fit_one_fold", "replace_target_rows", "one_replicate"
  )
  signature <- list(
    input_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum("analysis_data.rds")),
    spec = spec, horizon = WLAG, n_states = N_STATES, features_per = FEATURES_PER,
    predictors = predictor_names, exclusions = predictor_block_exclusions,
    common_exclude_states = COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES, lambdas = LAMBDAS,
    seeds = c(STATE_SEED_BASE, CV_SEED_BASE, ORIGIN_CV_SEED_BASE, POINT_SEED_BASE),
    control = glmnet::glmnet.control(), rng = RNGkind(), r_version = R.version.string,
    platform = R.version$platform,
    packages = vapply(c("glmnet", "Matrix", "dplyr", "purrr", "tibble", "splines"),
                     function(x) as.character(utils::packageVersion(x)), character(1)),
    fit_code = setNames(lapply(fit_functions, function(nm) {
      f <- get(nm, mode = "function")
      list(formals = formals(f), body = deparse(body(f), width.cutoff = 500L))
    }), fit_functions)
  )
  stopifnot(!anyNA(signature$input_md5))
  checkpoint_dir <- file.path(BOOTSTRAP_DIR, "checkpoints", model_name)
  dir.create(checkpoint_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  results <- lapply(seq_len(B), function(b) {
    path <- file.path(checkpoint_dir, sprintf("replicate_%03d.rds", b))
    if (file.exists(path)) {
      saved <- readRDS(path)
      if (!identical(saved$signature, signature)) {
        stop("Bootstrap inputs changed. Choose a new BOOTSTRAP_DIR.")
      }
      result <- saved$result
    } else {
      result <- one_replicate(b, spec, model_name)
      save_bootstrap_rds(list(signature = signature, result = result), path)
    }
    stopifnot(
      nrow(result$pred) == 2300L, all(result$pred$boot == b),
      !anyDuplicated(result$pred[c("state", "date")]),
      all(is.finite(result$pred$pred)), all(result$pred$pred >= 0),
      nrow(result$lambda) == 5L * WLAG
    )
    result
  })
  out <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, "pred"))
  attr(out, "lambda_log") <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, "lambda"))
  attr(out, "warning_log") <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, "warnings"))
  attr(out, "model_spec") <- spec[c("k", "combo_index", "combo")]
  attr(out, "signature") <- signature
  out
}

```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
boot_full_without <- run_bootstrap("without", B = B)
```

```{r}
  is.data.frame(state_population),

  dplyr::transmute(state = as.character(state), population = as.numeric(population)) %>%
```

```{r}
qfast <- function(x_sorted, p) {

  n <- length(x_sorted)

  stopifnot(
    n > 0L,
    all(is.finite(x_sorted)),
    all(p >= 0 & p <= 1)
  )

  x_sorted[pmax(1L, ceiling(n * p))]
}
nb_draws_sorted <- function(mean_rates, population, theta, M = DRAWS_PER_BOOT) {

  stopifnot(
    length(mean_rates) == B,
    all(is.finite(mean_rates)),
    all(mean_rates >= 0),
    length(population) == 1L,
    is.finite(population),
    population > 0,
    length(theta) == 1L,
    is.finite(theta),
    theta > 0,
    M >= 1L
  )

  pop_100k <- population / 1e5
  lambda   <- mean_rates * pop_100k

  draws <- stats::rnbinom(
    n = length(lambda) * M,
    mu = rep(lambda, each = M),
    size = theta
  )

  sort(draws / pop_100k)
}

core_scores <- function(draws_sorted, observed_rate, alphas = WIS_ALPHAS) {

  stopifnot(all(is.finite(draws_sorted)), is.finite(observed_rate))

  predictive_median <- qfast(draws_sorted, 0.50)

  lower_all <- qfast(draws_sorted, alphas / 2)
  upper_all <- qfast(draws_sorted, 1 - alphas / 2)

  over_pen <-
    (2 / alphas) * (lower_all - observed_rate) *
    as.numeric(observed_rate < lower_all)

  under_pen <-
    (2 / alphas) * (observed_rate - upper_all) *
    as.numeric(observed_rate > upper_all)

  denominator <- length(alphas) + 0.5

  wis_absolute_error <-
    0.5 * abs(observed_rate - predictive_median) / denominator
  wis_dispersion <-
    sum((alphas / 2) * (upper_all - lower_all)) / denominator
  wis_underprediction <-
    sum((alphas / 2) * under_pen) / denominator
  wis_overprediction <-
    sum((alphas / 2) * over_pen) / denominator

  pi_bounds <- qfast(draws_sorted, c(0.25, 0.75, 0.10, 0.90, 0.025, 0.975))

  c(
    predictive_median = predictive_median,

    wis = wis_absolute_error + wis_dispersion +
          wis_overprediction + wis_underprediction,
    wis_absolute_error = wis_absolute_error,
    wis_dispersion = wis_dispersion,
    wis_underprediction = wis_underprediction,
    wis_overprediction = wis_overprediction,

    lower_50 = pi_bounds[1], upper_50 = pi_bounds[2],
    lower_80 = pi_bounds[3], upper_80 = pi_bounds[4],
    lower_95 = pi_bounds[5], upper_95 = pi_bounds[6]
  )
}
```

```{r}
build_targets <- function(boot_df, label) {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(boot_df),
    all(c("state", "date", "obs", "pred", "boot") %in% names(boot_df)),
    is.numeric(boot_df$obs), is.numeric(boot_df$pred), is.numeric(boot_df$boot))
  d <- tibble::tibble(
    state = unname(as.character(boot_df$state)),
    date = as.Date(unname(as.numeric(as.Date(boot_df$date))), origin = "1970-01-01"),
    obs = as.numeric(boot_df$obs), pred = as.numeric(boot_df$pred),
    boot = as.numeric(boot_df$boot)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(state_population, by = "state") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(state, date, boot)

  expected_states <- setdiff(datasets::state.abb, c("IA", "MN", "MO", "OK"))
  stopifnot(nrow(d) == B * 2300L, !anyNA(d),
    !anyDuplicated(d[c("state", "date", "boot")]),
    setequal(d$state, expected_states),
    is.numeric(d$boot), setequal(d$boot, seq_len(B)),
    all(is.finite(d$population)), all(d$population > 0),
    all(is.finite(d$pred)), all(d$pred >= 0),
    all(is.finite(d$obs)), all(d$obs >= 0))

  ti <- d %>%
    dplyr::distinct(state, date, obs, population) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(state, date) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(target_id = dplyr::row_number())
  stopifnot(nrow(ti) == 2300L, !anyDuplicated(ti[c("state", "date")]),
    length(unique(ti$date)) == length(EVAL_DATES), all(sort(unique(ti$date)) == EVAL_DATES),
    all(as.integer(table(ti$date)) == 46L),
    all(as.integer(table(ti$state)) == 50L))
  ti <- ti %>%
    dplyr::mutate(fold = as.integer(ceiling(match(date, EVAL_DATES) / 10)))
  stopifnot(identical(as.integer(table(ti$fold)), rep(460L, 5L)))

  d <- d %>% dplyr::left_join(
    ti %>% dplyr::select(state, date, target_id), by = c("state", "date"))
  pred_list <- split(d$pred, d$target_id)
  pred_list <- pred_list[as.character(ti$target_id)]
  stopifnot(length(pred_list) == 2300L, all(lengths(pred_list) == B))
  list(target_info = ti, pred_list = pred_list)
}

eval_fold <- function(ti, pl, idx, theta, seed = CAL_SEED) {

  set.seed(seed)

  wis <- numeric(length(idx))
  hit50 <- logical(length(idx))
  hit80 <- logical(length(idx))
  hit95 <- logical(length(idx))

  for (k in seq_along(idx)) {

    i <- idx[k]

    s <- core_scores(
      draws_sorted = nb_draws_sorted(pl[[i]], ti$population[i], theta),
      observed_rate = ti$obs[i]
    )

    obs_i <- ti$obs[i]

    wis[k] <- s[["wis"]]
    hit50[k] <- obs_i >= s[["lower_50"]] && obs_i <= s[["upper_50"]]
    hit80[k] <- obs_i >= s[["lower_80"]] && obs_i <= s[["upper_80"]]
    hit95[k] <- obs_i >= s[["lower_95"]] && obs_i <= s[["upper_95"]]
  }

  list(
    mean_wis = mean(wis),
    coverage = c(cov50 = mean(hit50), cov80 = mean(hit80), cov95 = mean(hit95))
  )
}
```

```{r}
make_window_schedule <- function() {
  out <- lapply(11:50, function(j) {
    target <- EVAL_DATES[j]
    origin <- target - 7L * HORIZON
    dates <- utils::tail(EVAL_DATES[EVAL_DATES <= origin], WINDOW_WEEKS)
    stopifnot(length(dates) %in% 8:10, max(dates) <= origin, all(diff(dates) == 7))
    list(week_index = j, date = target, origin = origin, rolling_dates = dates)
  })
  stopifnot(
    identical(vapply(out, function(x) length(x$rolling_dates), integer(1)),
              c(8L, 9L, rep(10L, 38L))),
    identical(out[[1]]$rolling_dates, EVAL_DATES[1:8]),
    identical(out[[2]]$rolling_dates, EVAL_DATES[1:9]),
    identical(out[[3]]$rolling_dates, EVAL_DATES[1:10]),
    identical(out[[4]]$rolling_dates, EVAL_DATES[2:11]),
    identical(out[[40]]$rolling_dates, EVAL_DATES[38:47])
  )
  out
}


calibrate_window <- function(built, dates, origin, label, target) {
  ti <- built$target_info
  pl <- built$pred_list
  idx <- which(ti$date %in% dates)
  stopifnot(length(dates) %in% 8:10, max(dates) <= origin,
    length(idx) == 46L * length(dates),
    all(sort(unique(ti$date[idx])) == dates), all(ti$date[idx] <= origin))
  loss_of <- function(theta) {
    e <- eval_fold(ti, pl, idx, theta, seed = CAL_SEED)
    list(loss = sum((e$coverage - NOMINAL)^2),
      mean_wis = e$mean_wis, coverage = e$coverage)
  }
  lo <- THETA_GRID_LO
  hi <- THETA_GRID_HI
  n_expanded <- 0L
  history <- list()
  repeat {
    grid1 <- exp(seq(log(lo), log(hi), length.out = N_COARSE))
    result1 <- lapply(grid1, loss_of)
    loss1 <- vapply(result1, `[[`, numeric(1), "loss")
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(loss1)))
    best1 <- which.min(loss1)
    history[[length(history) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(
      theta = grid1, loss = loss1, stage = "coarse", expansion = n_expanded)
    if (!(best1 %in% c(1L, length(grid1)))) break
    new_lo <- lo
    new_hi <- hi
    if (best1 == 1L) new_lo <- max(HARD_THETA_LO, lo / EXPAND_FACTOR)
    if (best1 == length(grid1)) new_hi <- min(HARD_THETA_HI, hi * EXPAND_FACTOR)
    if ((new_lo == lo && new_hi == hi) || n_expanded >= MAX_GRID_EXPANSIONS) break
    lo <- new_lo
    hi <- new_hi
    n_expanded <- n_expanded + 1L
  }
  left <- max(1L, best1 - 1L)
  right <- min(length(grid1), best1 + 1L)
  grid2 <- exp(seq(log(grid1[left]), log(grid1[right]), length.out = N_FINE))
  result2 <- lapply(grid2, loss_of)
  loss2 <- vapply(result2, `[[`, numeric(1), "loss")
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(loss2)))
  best2 <- which.min(loss2)
  chosen <- result2[[best2]]
  theta <- grid2[best2]
  at_limit <- best1 %in% c(1L, length(grid1))
  refine_edge <- best2 %in% c(1L, length(grid2))
  history[[length(history) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(
    theta = grid2, loss = loss2, stage = "fine", expansion = n_expanded)
  list(theta = theta, objective = OBJECTIVE, dates = dates,
    calibration_start = min(dates), calibration_cutoff = max(dates),
    n_cal_weeks = length(dates), n_cal_targets = length(idx),
    cal_coverage = chosen$coverage, cal_mean_wis = chosen$mean_wis,
    calibration_loss = chosen$loss, grid_expansions = n_expanded,
    at_search_limit = at_limit, at_refinement_edge = refine_edge,
    grid = dplyr::bind_rows(history))
}
```

```{r}
score_week <- function(built, spec, cal, label, protocol) {
  ti <- built$target_info
  pl <- built$pred_list
  idx <- which(ti$date == spec$date)
  stopifnot(length(idx) == 46L, cal$calibration_cutoff <= spec$origin)
  mat <- matrix(NA_real_, length(idx), length(SCORE_COLUMNS),
    dimnames = list(NULL, SCORE_COLUMNS))
  for (k in seq_along(idx)) {
    i <- idx[k]
    set.seed(SCORE_SEED + ti$target_id[i])
    z <- core_scores(nb_draws_sorted(pl[[i]], ti$population[i], cal$theta), ti$obs[i])
    stopifnot(identical(names(z), SCORE_COLUMNS))
    mat[k, ] <- z
  }
  out <- dplyr::bind_cols(ti[idx, ], tibble::as_tibble(mat)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      model = .env$label, protocol = .env$protocol,
      forecast_origin = .env$spec$origin,
      theta_used = .env$cal$theta,
      calibration_start = .env$cal$calibration_start,
      calibration_cutoff = .env$cal$calibration_cutoff,
      n_cal_weeks = .env$cal$n_cal_weeks,
      score_seed = .env$SCORE_SEED + target_id,
      covered_50 = obs >= lower_50 & obs <= upper_50,
      width_50 = upper_50 - lower_50,
      covered_80 = obs >= lower_80 & obs <= upper_80,
      width_80 = upper_80 - lower_80,
      covered_95 = obs >= lower_95 & obs <= upper_95,
      width_95 = upper_95 - lower_95)
  out
}

validate_rows <- function(rows, built, spec = NULL) {
  expected <- built$target_info
  expected <- if (is.null(spec)) expected[expected$fold != 1L, ] else
    expected[expected$date == spec$date, ]
  actual <- rows %>% dplyr::arrange(state, date)
  expected <- expected %>% dplyr::arrange(state, date)
  stopifnot(nrow(actual) == nrow(expected),
    identical(actual$state, expected$state), all(actual$date == expected$date),
    identical(actual$obs, expected$obs), identical(actual$target_id, expected$target_id),
    !anyNA(actual), !anyDuplicated(actual[c("state", "date")]),
    all(is.finite(as.matrix(actual[, SCORE_COLUMNS]))),
    all(actual$theta_used > 0), all(is.finite(actual$theta_used)),
    all(actual$forecast_origin == actual$date - 21L),
    all(actual$calibration_start <= actual$calibration_cutoff),
    all(actual$calibration_cutoff <= actual$forecast_origin),
    all(actual$score_seed == SCORE_SEED + actual$target_id),
    all(actual$lower_95 <= actual$lower_80), all(actual$lower_80 <= actual$lower_50),
    all(actual$lower_50 <= actual$predictive_median),
    all(actual$predictive_median <= actual$upper_50),
    all(actual$upper_50 <= actual$upper_80), all(actual$upper_80 <= actual$upper_95),
    max(abs(actual$wis - (actual$wis_absolute_error + actual$wis_dispersion +
      actual$wis_overprediction + actual$wis_underprediction))) < 1e-10)
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
summarise_model <- function(rows, label) {
  rows %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      model = label, objective = OBJECTIVE, protocol = "ROLLING10",
      n_targets = dplyr::n(), n_states = dplyr::n_distinct(state),
      theta_min = min(theta_used), theta_max = max(theta_used),
      mean_wis = mean(wis),
      coverage_50 = mean(covered_50),
      coverage_80 = mean(covered_80),
      coverage_95 = mean(covered_95),
      mean_width_50 = mean(width_50),
      mean_width_80 = mean(width_80),
      mean_width_95 = mean(width_95)
    )
}

compare_states <- function(rows_with, rows_without) {
  state_with <- rows_with %>%
    dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(wis_with = mean(wis), .groups = "drop")
  state_without <- rows_without %>%
    dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(wis_without = mean(wis), .groups = "drop")
  dplyr::inner_join(state_with, state_without, by = "state") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(diff = wis_with - wis_without)
}

calibration_row <- function(cal, spec, label) {
  tibble::tibble(
    model = label, date = spec$date, forecast_origin = spec$origin,
    theta = cal$theta, calibration_start = cal$calibration_start,
    calibration_cutoff = cal$calibration_cutoff, n_cal_weeks = cal$n_cal_weeks,
    cal_coverage_50 = unname(cal$cal_coverage["cov50"]),
    cal_coverage_80 = unname(cal$cal_coverage["cov80"]),
    cal_coverage_95 = unname(cal$cal_coverage["cov95"]),
    cal_mean_wis = cal$cal_mean_wis, calibration_loss = cal$calibration_loss,
    grid_expansions = cal$grid_expansions,
    at_search_limit = cal$at_search_limit, at_refinement_edge = cal$at_refinement_edge
  )
}
```

```{r}
hash_object <- function(x) {
  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
  on.exit(unlink(f), add = TRUE)
  saveRDS(x, f, version = 2, compress = FALSE)
  unname(tools::md5sum(f))
}

run_one <- function(built, label) {
  had_rng <- exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  if (had_rng) saved_rng <- get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  on.exit({
    if (had_rng) {
      assign(".Random.seed", saved_rng, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    } else if (exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {
      rm(list = ".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
    }
  }, add = TRUE)

  weeks <- lapply(seq_along(schedule), function(j) {
    spec <- schedule[[j]]
    path <- file.path(run_dir, sprintf("%s_%02d.rds", tolower(label), j))
    reused <- file.exists(path)
    if (reused) {
      item <- readRDS(path)
    } else {
      cal <- calibrate_window(built, spec$rolling_dates, spec$origin, label, spec$date)
      item <- list(run_id = run_id, model = label, spec = spec, cal = cal,
                   rows = score_week(built, spec, cal, label, "ROLLING10"))
    }
    stopifnot(
      identical(item$run_id, run_id), identical(item$model, label),
      identical(item$spec, spec), identical(item$cal$dates, spec$rolling_dates),
      all(item$rows$model == label), all(item$rows$protocol == "ROLLING10"),
      all(item$rows$theta_used == item$cal$theta),
      all(item$rows$n_cal_weeks == length(spec$rolling_dates)),
      all(item$rows$calibration_start == min(spec$rolling_dates)),
      all(item$rows$calibration_cutoff == max(spec$rolling_dates))
    )
    validate_rows(item$rows, built, spec)
    if (!reused) save_bootstrap_rds(item, path)
    item
  })
  rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(weeks, `[[`, "rows")) %>% dplyr::arrange(state, date)
  validate_rows(rows, built)
  cal <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(weeks, function(w) calibration_row(w$cal, w$spec, label)))
  grids <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(weeks, function(w) {
    dplyr::mutate(w$cal$grid, model = label, date = w$spec$date)
  }))
  list(cal = cal, rows = rows, summary = summarise_model(rows, label), grids = grids)
}
```
